name: Maester
description_en: Maester by BuzzClan is a connected-document governance product. Evaluate its human review, retention and response boundaries before relying on automated classification.
description_zh: BuzzClan 的 Maester 是连接现有文档来源的治理产品。依赖自动分类前，应评估人工复核、保留和响应边界。

core_features.explanation_en: Review AI classifications before policy decisions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 作出策略决定前复核 AI 分类。

en: Evaluate a synthetic records response with classification review, hold and export questions.
zh: 用模拟记录响应评估分类复核、保全及导出问题。

sections.title_en: A governance layer over selected sources
sections.title_zh: 选定来源之上的治理层
sections.en:
The current Maester page describes connecting existing content, AI-assisted discovery/classification, human review, retention and legal holds. Its examples include SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive, network drives, Outlook/Exchange and Box. No migration requirement is advertised.

For an editorial pilot, choose one synthetic records request and a small, separately permissioned folder. Put a fictional invoice, a revised invoice and an unrelated memo in it. Define which is authoritative and which records the requester should receive. Ask for a connector-specific diagram covering originals, extracted text, indexes, temporary copies and logs. “No migration” does not answer where those derivatives reside or how deletion reaches them. This is a proposed evaluation, not an observed deployment.
sections.zh:
当前 Maester 页面描述连接现有内容、AI 辅助发现分类、人工复核、保留及法律保全，来源示例包括 SharePoint、OneDrive、Google Drive、网络盘、Outlook／Exchange 和 Box，并宣传无需迁移。

建议试点选择一个模拟记录请求及独立授权的小文件夹，放入虚构发票、修订发票和无关备忘录，明确哪份是权威记录、请求者应收到哪些文件。应索取目标连接器的数据流图，覆盖原件、提取文字、索引、临时副本和日志。“无需迁移”不回答这些衍生数据在哪里及如何传播删除。这是建议评估，不是已观察的部署。

sections.title_en: Review classification, retention and response separately
sections.title_zh: 分类、保留与响应分别复核
sections.en:
Authorized reviewers can override classifications; the page also describes review/redaction/approval/response packages. Access-control preservation is a vendor claim, without a published enforcement procedure in the reviewed page.

For the fictional invoice, write the expected class and retention trigger first. Record the reviewer, decision and reason when a suggested class is wrong. Then ask how an active hold affects scheduled destruction, who may release it and what happens after release. Request evidence using an ordinary identity and a denied identity; an administrator demonstration alone cannot establish the boundary. Check a response package for the intended version, redacted values and accidental originals or metadata. These checks are proposed acceptance questions. The public overview does not establish precedence, retries, reversible redaction, recovery or a legally sufficient response.
sections.zh:
获授权复核者可覆盖分类；页面还描述审阅、涂黑、批准及响应资料包。保留访问控制属于厂商主张，已读页面没有公布执行程序。

对虚构发票应先写预期类别及保留起算点，分类建议错误时记录复核者、决定和原因，再确认生效保全如何影响计划销毁、谁能解除及解除后的行为。使用普通身份和被拒身份取证，单独管理员演示不足以确立边界。响应包需检查目标版本、涂黑值及意外原件或元数据。这些是建议验收问题，公开概述未确立优先级、重试、可逆涂黑、恢复或法律上充分的响应。

sections.en:
The page separates Essential discovery/classification, Professional retention/approval/holds and Enterprise custom governance. It publishes no monetary rate; minimum commitment, billing unit, trial and sustained-free access remain unknown.

A useful quote request would specify repository count, document volume, scan frequency, reviewers, request volume and deployment constraints. Ask whether a fresh scan, reprocessing an updated file, retained index or response export consumes a separate allowance. Include setup, connector changes, training and exit assistance in the comparison. Do not turn a contact button into a confirmed price or infer that a small source set will be free. Exact connector availability and support obligations need the offered agreement. No enquiry, demo request, subscription or payment was submitted.
sections.zh:
页面区分 Essential 的发现分类、Professional 的保留审批保全及 Enterprise 的自定义治理，未公布金额；最低承诺、计费单位、试用和持续免费权益未知。

有用的报价请求应列明库数量、文档量、扫描频率、复核人数、请求量及部署限制，确认首次扫描、更新文件再处理、保留索引或导出响应是否分别消耗额度，并纳入实施、连接器变更、培训和退出协助。联系按钮不构成已确认价格，也不能推断小来源集免费。准确连接器可用性和支持义务需依报价协议。本研究未询价、请求演示、订阅或支付。

sections.title_en: General privacy text leaves product questions open
sections.title_zh: 通用隐私文本仍留下产品问题
sections.en:
BuzzClan’s linked policy says Updated August 2023 and describes general personal-data handling and service providers. It is not a Maester-specific DPA, full software license or deployment specification.

Before evaluating real records, obtain the applicable processing agreement, hosting region, model-provider route, subprocessor list, retention of extracted data and logs, support access and termination export/deletion terms. Ask which evidence can be exported with a record and which remains only in the service. This product suits evaluation by records and information-governance owners; a team seeking basic file editing should first establish whether adding this governance layer solves a defined problem. No account, connector, source folder, classification, hold, response, deletion or data transfer was operated. License openness and interface languages remain unknown.
sections.zh:
BuzzClan 链接的政策正文写明 Updated August 2023，描述通用个人资料处理及服务提供方，不是 Maester 专属 DPA、完整软件许可或部署规格。

评估真实记录前需取得适用处理协议、托管地区、模型提供方路径、分处理方清单、提取数据及日志保留、支持访问和终止后导出删除条款，并确认哪些证据可随记录导出、哪些只留在服务中。建议由记录和信息治理负责人评估；仅需基础文件编辑的团队应先明确额外治理层解决什么问题。本研究未操作账户、连接器、源文件夹、分类、保全、响应、删除或数据传输。开源许可和界面语言未知。
